Cc: procurement@carespring.health
Date: Fri, 10 Aug 2028 09:15:00 +0000
Subject: Renewal + residency: EU primary, APAC pilot during extension

Karthik,

We're coming up on our Jan 1 renewal and procurement asked me to clarify the region/residency plan before they start the PO. Our priorities: keep primary EU residency for PHI, stage an APAC pilot for latency-sensitive users, and a clear failover/backstop policy.

Can Redwood outline what changes in the term would look like (commit, SLA, pricing deltas) if we: 1) add an APAC warm-chain pilot for 3 months, and 2) require a documented EU-edge preservation guarantee with audit logs enabled?

We also need a short mutual action plan (MAP) so procurement can slot dates. Can you send that over?

Thanks,
Emma Li
VP Ops, CareSpring Health

Emma — thanks for the clear ask. High-level response below and attaching a draft MAP and redlined SLA for procurement. See attachments: mutual_action_plan_v2.xlsx; SLA_proposal_redline.pdf.

Summary (TL;DR):
- EU primary residency preserved in term language (data-at-rest & audit logs) — no extra term needed but we add an "edge-preservation" clause and quarterly evidence export for the first year.
- APAC warm-chain pilot: 3-month pilot billed as a usage add-on + one-time onboarding/ops fee. Pilot uses warm standby nodes (no hot mirroring) with warm-chain failover trigger for defined maintenance windows and incident scenarios.
- Cross-region failover: documented backstop routes to EU primary within 60 minutes for active sessions; for stateful workloads we recommend prefix/KV sync cadence (we'll detail in runbook).

Next steps I propose:
1) Review attached MAP and redline by Mon 2028-08-15.
2) Procurement to confirm budget; we can provide a DocuSign-ready amendment once terms accepted.
3) Technical onboarding with Ben to confirm warm-chain footprint (estimated +40% token throughput during failover windows).

Ben — can you add a short note on the ops expectations (KV sync, cache preservation) and call out any quota changes to the MAP?

Best,
Karthik Iyer
Director, Strategic Accounts | Redwood Inference
karthik@redwood.com
From: ben_carter <ben@redwood.com>

Cc: kimberly_park <kimberly@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 13 Aug 2028 09:22:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Renewal + residency: EU primary, APAC pilot during extension

Emma / Karthik — technical clarifications from the serving/runtime side below. Brief and actionable.

- Warm-chain pilot model: we recommend 2 warm nodes in APAC (one compute, one standby) with prefix/KV sync every 5 minutes for session state; this keeps cold-starts minimal. During failover windows we can tolerate up to 120s token-latency inflation while we promote warm to hot.
- Cost impact: pilot baseline = +30% on hosted token cost for APAC footprint while pilot active; a resiliency buffer (hot moment) estimated at +40% delta for peak failover windows. We'll quantify in the MAP.
- Audit/evidence: we can generate custody logs and a weekly residency snapshot S3 export to your audit bucket (encrypted).

Action: I've updated the MAP (tab "ops_notes") with the above and added an ops-runbook outline. Kimberly — can you confirm billing line item language for the pilot?

Cheers,
Ben Carter
Senior Solutions Architect, Redwood Inference
